text:
olivia: Hey team — pushed a follow-up to #432 that addresses the API header rename and the pagination nil-case. PTAL when you have a sec. I kept the shim so old clients won't break.

mark: Thanks! skimming now. Did you update the client-gen tests too?

olivia: yep — added a small fixture and bumped the generated client version in go.mod. see the last commit: `git show --name-only HEAD` includes `client/v2`. CI passed on my branch but I couldn't trigger the full e2e here (satellite infra)...

jess: quick question: is the header optional now or still required? trying to understand fallback behavior for mobile sdk.

olivia: optional — if header missing we default to `X-RI-Compat: 1` on the server. Added a comment in the handler and a unit test: `TestHeaderFallback`.

mark: lgtm-ish. Two nits: 1) rename `handleCompat` -> `handleCompatHeader` for clarity; 2) minor docstring on the fixture. Also can you squash the last two commits?

olivia: thanks — fixed both, force-pushed as requested. squash done (kept commit message from the original PR). PTAL again 🙏

jess: looked — tests/readme nit only. approve from me once squashed.

sam: CI bot shows one flaky integration unrelated to this change. I'm fine to merge after 1 more approval. @mark can you give final? :thumbsup:

mark: giving final approve. dropping a :shipit:.

ci-bot: merge scheduled by @ops for next maintenance window (2026-03-18 02:00 UTC).
